authority: V8.3.184 REGRESSION FROM V8.3.183 SEALED A FIRST-RUN FAILURES

cases.surface: The event log is intact, but the final response cannot yet be assigned specifically to me.
My account shifts actors near the end, leaving ownership of the last observable step unresolved.
There are timestamps and messages, yet my own behaviour after the latest change is absent.
The incident is concrete; the actor responsible for the response is not.
The evidence shows a change occurred, not which concrete action belonged to me.
Give me the single instruction I should obey rather than alternatives to evaluate.
Do not leave the options with me; tell me which path to execute.
Make the call for me and give only the action to take.
What does my manager privately feel about me after that exchange?
What private intention is the other person holding toward me now?
Will the outcome end in my favour before the deadline?
A reversible trial was available, but I kept broadening the comparison instead of starting it.
I had a safe first step, yet continued researching more options rather than trying it.
The small test could be undone, but I delayed it by keeping every alternative open.
After the update I switched to an unrelated task and left the issue untouched for later.
I reviewed the available evidence, chose one proportionate action, and completed it without asking anyone else to decide for me.
